WITH matched_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM riskandmargin rm
  INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count
  FROM matched_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    mc.ordertune,
    mc.order_count,
    ac.avg_count,
    mc.order_count - ac.avg_count as excess
  FROM matched_counts mc
  CROSS JOIN average_count ac
  WHERE mc.order_count > ac.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(order_count) as avg_of_counts,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_average
